parsed_json.up: Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target_dictionary to target_components on tid, then to component_sequences on component_id. Filter where target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Alias chembl_id as target_chembl_id, pref_name as target_name, accession as protein_accession, and sequence as protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
